waiver: S1 (fork stamping `served` onto step-finish parts) is blocked on AJ's authorization and out of scope. This slice defines and builds against the synthetic contract below, which S1 must satisfy once approved.

served_step_finish_part_contract.description: Once S1 lands, an engine step-finish part carries an additional `served` object alongside its existing fields. Until then, `served` is absent and the step is counted unattributed.

served.modelID: string — the model that actually served this step (provider-reported, sanitized to '<unrecognized>' if out of shape)
served.responseID: string, optional — upstream generation id if the provider supplied one
served.requestModelID: string, optional — the alias/model that was requested for this step

criteria.text: A step-finish part carrying `served` inserts exactly one agent_served_steps row; a duplicate event is idempotent; message.removed does not delete the row
An out-of-shape served.modelID is stored as '<unrecognized>'; agent_served_steps carries identifier columns only, no content
GET /agent-sessions/:id/model-provenance returns servedModels in first-seen order, multiModel, routed, steps.unattributed; 404 for unknown session; GET /agent-sessions/:id unaffected
Delegation status view includes servedModels per delegation
Under Postgres, repository methods refuse before touching SQLite; skill_schema_parity.test.ts and live_postgres_bootstrap.test.ts pass unchanged

caveats: S1 has not landed: in production today no step-finish part carries `served`, so agent_served_steps stays empty and every step-finish is 'unattributed'. This slice is exercised only against synthetic parts shaped per the contract above.
routed/servedModels are read from the local ledger only; steps.unattributed is read from parts_json directly, since an unattributed step never reaches the ledger by definition.
agent_served_steps is deliberately excluded from postgres_bootstrap.ts and the skill_schema_parity table list, exactly like agent_turn_dispatches (B1) — SQLite-local only.
No live OpenRouter/loopback-stub proof was run (network/live-provider work is explicitly out of scope for this sandboxed slice); see the issue's 'Live proof' remaining-work item.
S3 (dispatch-ledger wiring at the prompt/promptAsync choke point) was explicitly optional for this slice and was not built — agent_turn_dispatches (B1) still has zero production callers.
